label.purpose: 统计标签和页脚产品名。

shadows.name: card-rest
shadows.purpose: 亮色指标卡和海报的休息阴影。

shadows.name: card-rest-dark
shadows.purpose: 暗色同一位置，略加深但不做光晕。

motion.name: ease-standard

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: 主操作：保存、升级、批量修复。
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #4c5fd5; color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 14px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3e4ec4; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3e4ec4; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #3e4ec4; }

components.name: Primary Button Hover
components.css: .ds-btn-primary-hover { background: #3e4ec4; color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 14px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary-hover:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3e4ec4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: 刷新、取消、次要操作；描边不铺主色。
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #1f2937; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid #e6e8f0; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f8f9fd; border-color: #d7dae6; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3e4ec4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: 设置页输入。placeholder 只举例，可见 label 在表单项上。
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; max-width: 420px; } .ds-field-label { color: #1f2937; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #e6e8f0; border-radius: 8px; background: #ffffff; color: #1f2937; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #5f6b7a; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #d7dae6; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3e4ec4; outline-offset: 1px; border-color: #4c5fd5; }

components.name: Sheet Card
components.description: 设置分区、指标和队列容器。
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; color: #1f2937; border: 1px solid #e6e8f0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 16px 18px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20, 24, 41, 0.04); max-width: 240px; } .ds-card-label { color: #5f6b7a; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-value { margin-top: 5px; color: #141829; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Kind Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 6px; background: #f8f9fd; border: 1px solid #e6e8f0; color: #4b5563; font-size: 11px; line-height: 18px; } .ds-chip-kind { background: #eef0fc; border-color: transparent; color: #4c5fd5; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Side Nav
components.description: 当前项用软主色底，不用粗彩条。
components.html: 运行概览质量巡检设置
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; width: 220px; padding: 8px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e6e8f0; border-radius: 10px; } .ds-nav-item { padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: #1f2937; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #f8f9fd; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3e4ec4; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-item.is-active { background: #eef0fc; color: #3e4ec4; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Theme Toggle
components.description: 顶栏 44×44 主题切换，必须有可见名称。
components.html: <button class="ds-theme-toggle" type="button" aria-label="暗色 · 点击恢复跟随系统"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M21 12.79A9 9 0 1 1 11.21 3 7 7 0 0 0 21 12.79z" /></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-theme-toggle { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid #e6e8f0; border-radius: 8px; background: #ffffff; color: #4b5563; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-theme-toggle:hover { background: #f8f9fd; border-color: #d7dae6; color: #1f2937; } .ds-theme-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3e4ec4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Log Console
components.description: 两种主题都保持深底终端。
components.html:
[info] runner heartbeat ok
[warning] lock wait 12s
[error] cms upgrade rolled back
components.css: .ds-log { margin: 0; padding: 9px 12px; background: #111827; border: 1px solid #243044; border-radius: 8px; color: #d7deea; font: 12px/1.55 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; white-space: pre-wrap; } .ds-log-info { color: #d7deea; } .ds-log-warn { color: #f6c85f; } .ds-log-error { color: #ff8585; }

narrative.overview:
这是家庭媒体库旁边的一张安静工作台，不是 NAS 插件后台。默认克制：浅纸色底、细描边、几乎没有阴影；只有任务卡住、质量告警、解锁花费积分时才提高音量。暗色模式改成分层表面，而不是把浅色反相。

文字用系统中西文黑体，不加载网红英文字体。品牌落在精确的靛蓝主色、表格数字和确认文案上，不靠装饰。
keyCharacteristics: 异常优先，首页只回答现在是否正常
亮色细边 + 一层轻阴影；暗色只用色阶分层
主色少用，留给链接、主按钮和当前导航
危险操作先说后果，再让人确认

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: 主色出现面积不超过一屏的一成。统计数字用墨色，不用主色。

rules.name: The No Costume Mono Rule
rules.body: 等宽字体只用于日志、版本和命令，不拿来装「很技术」。

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: 休息状态用边框。阴影不作为装饰光晕。

dos: Do 用 token，不要在组件里另写一套蓝。
Do 给每个输入可见名称。
Do 在会改任务或容器的操作前说明后果。
Do 窄屏把宽表收成卡片。
donts: Don't 用 Inter / Geist / Plus Jakarta 这类网红英文字体。
Don't 把内部 action key 写在按钮上。
Don't 把底层日志堆到首页。
Don't 为了「更炫」加渐变字或玻璃拟态。
